items.question: To whom do the provisions concerning goddesses of different seats and the root linga apply?
premises: Goddesses of different seats are mentioned as a subject of concern.
The root linga is mentioned alongside them.
Twice-born ones are explicitly addressed or designated.
items.inference: The provisions concerning goddesses of different seats and the root linga are directed to the twice-born ones.
uncertainties: The specific ritual action or rule governing these elements is not stated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: But, O twice-born ones, this concerns the goddesses of different seats and the root linga.
